source.title: File:Haval H6 (53612059058).jpg
source.author: Jason Lawrence from New York
source.description: Seen in Kingston, Jamaica. Haval is a division of Great Wall Motors, one of China's ten largest vehicle manufacturers. Haval specializes in SUVs and Crossovers, and the H6 is one of the brand's main compact crossover offerings. This third generation model was introduced in 2020, and can be had with mild hybrid, regular hybrid, and plug-in hybrid forms, in addition to regular combustion variants. The 3rd generation H6 is built in factories in Pakistan and Thailand in addition to China, and exported widely to the developing world, including South Africa, the Philippines, Indonesia and Mexico, among many others. In Jamaica, Haval has not been present for too long (and Great Wall branded pickups have been around only moderately longer) but has substantially enhanced its footprint on the island within the last 3 to 5 years.
